subject: Vanguard.ai throughput surge — RCA delivery & executive commitments
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@vanguard.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@vanguard.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden throughput spike this morning — need immediate review

Kimberly —

We experienced a sustained spike in inference latency and 5xx errors for a 20-minute window ~07:30–07:50 PT this morning. Impact: several customer-facing flows timed out and some batch jobs retried heavily. Our retention team flagged ~18% higher error rate and a spike in token cost.

Can your team confirm root cause and provide a timeline for mitigation? We need an exec-ready summary as procurement is asking for credit remediation. Priya is on copy for billing.

Attaching a short metrics export.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Brooks
Director of Engineering, Vanguard.ai
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@vanguard.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput spike this morning — need immediate review

Evan —

Thank you for the data. I’m escalating to the ops & infra leads now. Initial check shows a combination of an unusually large tail of long-context requests (generated by a partner integration) plus a partial cache invalidation that reduced KV reuse. We’ll triage and follow up within 2 hours with an immediate mitigation plan.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Any recent changes on your side that increased long sequences?
- Can you share an example payload (anonymized) that hit the spike?

I’ll schedule a 30-minute bridge and loop in CS for customer-facing comms.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Logs and preliminary findings (internal)

Forwarding internal notes from infra:

--- Forwarded message ---
From: infra-alerts@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T10:13:00-07:00
Subject: [ALERT] Partial KV cache TTL drop during 07:28–07:52 PT

Summary: automated eviction triggered for a subset of models due to a metrics mis-bin; eviction affected ~12% of live keyspaces leading to repeated decoder work and elevated p99 latency. Concurrently we observed a burst of requests with sequence lengths > 4096 tokens from client tokenization logs (client_id=vg-integration-3).

Actions taken:
- Rehydrated KV cache from snapshot (07:20 state) — restored hit-rate to baseline at 07:56 PT.
- Temporarily throttled very long-context requests via policy to protect latency SLOs.

Next steps (for RCA):
1) Why eviction rule misfired — tracing to metrics ingestion pipeline (Karthik/infra)
2) Confirm partner integration change — request payload sample from Vanguard
3) Define permanent guardrail (cache eviction safety check + long-context rate limits)

Jonas
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@vanguard.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@vanguard.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput spike this morning — need immediate review

Evan / Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the sample payload — that confirmed the long-context pattern. Short update and ask:

What we did (what you can tell execs now):
- Identified root causes: (1) transient cache eviction triggered by metrics ingestion mis-binning; (2) recent upstream integration sent ~30% of requests with >4096 tokens.
- Immediate mitigations: cache snapshot rehydration (restored at 07:56 PT), temporary request throttling for sequences >4500 tokens, and increased throttling headroom for your account for the next 72 hours.
- Impact: p95/p99 latency restored to baseline within ~20 minutes after mitigation; estimated incremental token cost impact: $1.8k during window.

Commitments we are making (internal ownership & timeline):
- Karthik: investigate ingestion rule and deploy a fail-safe by 2026-10-15 EOD (prevent auto-eviction on noisy bins).
- Jonas/Infra: implement eviction safety check and improve cache snapshot cadence by 2026-10-18.
- Kimberly/CS: propose customer remediation (billing credit and health check) by 2026-10-14.

Attached: draft RCA (v1) and raw metrics extract. We’ll convert RCA to an exec brief for your leadership.

Could you confirm whether a credit or one-month free buffer would be acceptable as a starting point for procurement?

—Kimberly
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@vanguard.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@vanguard.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput spike this morning — need immediate review

Kimberly —

Thanks for the fast response and the mitigation. Procurement is OK with a credit discussion but execs want an assurance itemized in an SLA addendum about protection from noisy long-context integrations. They asked for:
- A written guardrail/limit and how it will be enforced
- A timeline for the platform fixes

Please treat this as high priority; I’ll need the exec brief before our leadership sync on 10/15.

Regards,
Priya Shah
VP of Operations, Vanguard.ai
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@vanguard.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@vanguard.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Vanguard exec brief + remediation plan (RCA final + commitments)

Priya / Evan —

Attached is the final exec brief and remediation tracker we will present to your leadership. High-level summary:

1) Incident summary
- Window: 2026-10-12 07:28–07:52 PT
- Root causes: metrics ingestion mis-binning -> transient KV cache eviction (~12% keyspace); concurrent burst of >4096-token requests from partner integration; absence of eviction safety checks.
- Impact: elevated p99 latency (2.8x baseline) and ~18% increase in 5xx rate; estimated incremental token cost $1.8k and customer-facing timeouts for a small subset of calls.

2) Actions completed
- Restored cache snapshot (07:56 PT) and temporary throttles placed.
- Customer notified; sample payload validated.

3) Concrete commitments (owner & date)
- Karthik Iyer (Infra): deploy ingestion-rule guardrail and mute noisy bins by 2026-10-15 EOD.
- Jonas Weber (Infra): implement eviction-safety check + automatic cache snapshotting (daily) by 2026-10-18.
- Grace O'Connor (CS): finalize remediation offer (billing credit + 1-month buffer) and deliver formal letter by 2026-10-15.
- Kimberly Park (Sales Ops): update account SLA addendum language and circulate by 2026-10-16.

4) Monitoring & verification
- We’ll add a dedicated alert for long-context request rate per account (threshold: 5% of traffic >4k tokens) and schedule a joint post-implementation sanity check on 2026-10-20.

5) Next steps for Vanguard leaders
- Approve remediation offer (credit + buffer) or propose alternative by 2026-10-15 noon PT.
- Share any policy constraints procurement requires for a formal addendum.

Attachments: vanguard_rca_draft.pdf (RCA executive brief), action_tracker_sheet.xlsx (live tracker), vanguard_metrics_export_1012.csv (raw metrics).

If approved, I’ll coordinate a 20-minute executive walkthrough with our CTO and Head of Infra next week.

Thanks for partnering on this — we recognize the disruption and want to make this right.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0132
